```{ojs}
//| output: false
data = FileAttachment("../posts/utah-bikeways/_output/miles_by_city.csv").csv({typed: true})
types = ["Paved Path", "Protected Bike Lane", "Bike Lane", "Marked Route", "Unmarked Route"]
```

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof bikeTypes = Inputs.checkbox(types, {
  label: "Facility types",
  value: ["Paved Path", "Protected Bike Lane"]
})
viewof searchCity = Inputs.text({placeholder: "e.g. Salt Lake City", label: "Highlight city"})
```

Each dot is a Utah municipality. The share is the selected bikeway miles divided by total road lane miles.

[Read the analysis &rarr;](../posts/utah-bikeways/index.html){.no-external target='_self'}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
rows = data
  .filter(d => d.Name && d.Name !== "NA" && d["All Roads"] > 0)
  .map(d => {
    const bike = bikeTypes.reduce((a, t) => a + (d[t] || 0), 0);
    return {...d, bike, ratio: bike / d["All Roads"] * 100};
  })
avgRatio = d3.mean(rows, d => d.ratio)
rowsTagged = rows.map(d => ({...d, group: d.ratio >= avgRatio ? "Above average" : "Below average"}))
highlighted = rowsTagged.filter(d => searchCity && d.Name.toLowerCase().includes(searchCity.toLowerCase()))
totalBike = d3.sum(rows, d => d.bike)
totalRoad = d3.sum(rows, d => d["All Roads"])
top = d3.greatest(rows.filter(d => d["All Roads"] > 100), d => d.ratio)
```

## Main


```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "Statewide bikeway share of roads"
//| icon: percent
//| color: '#A23E02'
html`${(totalBike / totalRoad * 100).toFixed(1)}%`
```

```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "Highest share (over 100 road miles)"
//| icon: trophy
//| color: '#1A2B35'
html`${top.Name} ${top.ratio.toFixed(1)}%`
```

### Row {height=74%}

#### Column {width=60%}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Bikeway miles against road miles"
Plot.plot({
  width: 720,
  height: 440,
  marginBottom: 44,
  grid: true,
  x: {label: "Total road miles (log) →", type: "log", domain: [10, 5000]},
  y: {label: "Selected bikeway miles (log) →", type: "log", domain: [0.1, 500]},
  color: {domain: ["Above average", "Below average"], range: ["#007EA7", "#D96E34"], legend: true},
  style: {backgroundColor: "transparent", fontSize: "12px"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(d3.range(10, 5000, 100), {x: d => d, y: d => d * avgRatio / 100, stroke: "#888", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),
    Plot.dot(rowsTagged.filter(d => d.bike > 0), {x: "All Roads", y: "bike", stroke: "group", fill: "group", fillOpacity: 0.3, r: 4, tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.Name}
Bikeway: ${d.bike.toFixed(1)} mi
Roads: ${d["All Roads"]} mi
Share: ${d.ratio.toFixed(1)}%`}),
    Plot.dot(highlighted, {x: "All Roads", y: "bike", stroke: "currentColor", strokeWidth: 2, r: 8}),
    Plot.text(highlighted, {x: "All Roads", y: "bike", text: "Name", dy: -16, fontWeight: "bold", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 4, paintOrder: "stroke", fill: "#333"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Top 12 by bikeway miles"
Plot.plot({

  x: {label: null, grid: true, ticks: 4},
  y: {label: null},
  color: {domain: ["Above average", "Below average"], range: ["#007EA7", "#D96E34"]},
  style: {backgroundColor: "transparent", fontSize: "12px"},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(d3.sort(rowsTagged, d => -d.bike).slice(0, 12), {x: "bike", y: "Name", fill: "group", sort: {y: "-x"}, tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.Name}
Bikeway: ${d.bike.toFixed(1)} mi
Share: ${d.ratio.toFixed(1)}%`}),
    Plot.text(d3.sort(rowsTagged, d => -d.bike).slice(0, 12), {x: "bike", y: "Name", text: d => `${d.bike.toFixed(1)} mi · ${d.ratio.toFixed(0)}%`, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10}),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
